summary.headline: APDerm captures $1.18M in annual savings across 12 spend categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners executed a two-phase strategic sourcing program for Adult & Pediatric Dermatology, driving $1,179,965 in annual savings. More than $861K is already locked in through executed contracts and implemented price files, while another $318K is moving through final contracting and rollout. Wins span Medical & Office Supplies, Courier and Telecom services, as well as new Phase-2 categories such as Billing Services and Janitorial, all achieved with minimal vendor disruption by leveraging RFPs, GPO pricing and incumbent negotiations.

total_annual_savings.notes: Sum of finalized ($861,880) plus in-progress ($318,085) savings.

impact.operational_improvements: Standardized pricing and terms across 30+ locations, consolidated suppliers in key categories, and leveraged national GPO agreements to ensure price holds during a volatile supply-chain environment.
